page.overview:
What is Sabbat?

Tzimisce (plurality)|predecessor=*Anarchs

The Sabbat is a loose organization of Cainites who reject the Traditions and the rule of the Camarilla. It formed primarily from those anarchs who refused to submit to the Convention of Thorns following the Anarch Revolt. Unlike the Ivory Tower, the Sabbat believes in the Antediluvians and Caine. The Sabbat is also known as the Sword of Caine, as it believes it will serve as Caine's army to destroy the Antediluvians once Gehenna arrives.

As of V5, the Sabbat appears to have fractured after the , sacrificing its domains to wage a war on the Ancients in the Middle East and war-torn regions around the globe, known as the Gehenna Crusade.

The Sabbat was essentially founded in 1493 CE, largely in reaction to the Convention of Thorns that ended the Anarch Revolt. The sect's earliest members were the many anarchs who refused to submit to the hegemony of the Camarilla or the unfair terms of the Treaty of Thorns, who existed in the wilderness as roving packs that harassed the holdings of elders and those who had submitted to the Camarilla.

Also known as: The Sabbat, Sabbat sect.
